thread:
mira: Hey team — onboarding call for OrbitalHealth POC this afternoon. They've asked for strict data locality to EU and APAC, and BYOK for EU. Short list of asks below.

alex-eng: Quick list?

mira: 1) Confirm which regions we can pin tenant traffic to (eu-west-1, eu-central-1, ap-southeast-1). 2) Confirm subprocessor list for those regions. 3) KMS available in eu-central? 4) Egress path proof for legal.

sam-ops: We can pin to eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 for hosted; APAC is ap-southeast-1 (limited beta). KMS: we have customer-managed keys in eu-central via partner KMS but needs attestation.

sam-ops: FYI there's a routing fallback — if capacity exhausted we'll failover to compatible EU instance; can't guarantee strict in an unreserved hosted tier.

mira: @sam-ops need precise wording for RFP: "tenant traffic will remain within EU unless customer opts into APAC"; can you draft line?

sam-ops: Draft: "Primary data path and inference execution will be routed to customer-designated EU regions. In the event of capacity constraints routed failover may occur within the EU region set. No cross-border failover to non-EU regions will be performed for EU-pinned tenants unless explicitly configured." Thoughts?

alex-eng: Looks good. Add note re: BYOK: "BYOK support requires Dedicated or Private deployment; for hosted BYOK we support key wrapping via partner KMS with attestation and limited availability." Need legal to confirm.

jess-legal: @mira @alex-eng I can provide subprocessor attestation. Need list of subprocessors by region. Also need egress controls and IP ranges for DD.

mira: attaching IP list in thread.

sam-ops: ```
Allowed egress CIDRs:
52.48.0.0/14 (eu-west)
18.194.0.0/15 (eu-central)
13.250.0.0/16 (ap-southeast)
```

mira: Customer asked about change control: they want 30 days notice for subprocessor additions. Ok?

jess-legal: Standard is 30 days + opt-out for material changes. We'll propose that.

mira: Pricing question: they want cost delta for Dedicated vs Hosted for EU-pin and BYOK. Can somebody estimate?

alex-eng: Rough: Hosted EU-pin (no SLA) = base price + 20% for region isolation. Dedicated (monthly reserved) adds ~3x of hosted per throughput unit due to reserved GPU. BYOK + attestation adds one-time onboarding $12k and monthly KMS pass-through costs.

mira: I'll put numbers in the proposal (ballpark) and note subject to SOW.

ops-bot: NOTE: region eu-central KMS attestation pending — ticket #ENG-4821

sam-ops: @mira I'll open a runbook with ops on the fallback policies and include capacity thresholds and MQ for failover.

mira: Thanks. Last ask: customer wants a short runbook snippet we can give them for security questionnaire — can we produce a 1-page summary?

jess-legal: I'll draft the 1-pager: subproc list, KMS availability, egress CIDRs, data retention, ability to pin tenant, change control. ETA EOD.

mira: Perfect. Meeting at 3pm — I'll share final answers. Thanks :thumbsup:
